# One saga's timeline

**Simulated result.** Generated by `make report`. Scenario S7: the pivot is
refused, the compensation chain runs, one compensation exhausts its attempts,
an operator resumes it, and the chain finishes.

```text
seq | time     | event | step | reason code | detail
01 | 09:00:00 | transition | — | STARTED | saga started
02 | 09:00:00 | step_dispatched | reserve_stock | DISPATCHED | attempt 1 to inventory
03 | 09:00:00 | step_accepted | reserve_stock | STEP_ACCEPTED | accepted as inventory-1
04 | 09:00:00 | step_dispatched | authorize_payment | DISPATCHED | attempt 1 to payments
05 | 09:00:00 | step_accepted | authorize_payment | STEP_ACCEPTED | accepted as payments-1
06 | 09:00:00 | step_dispatched | book_shipment | DISPATCHED | attempt 1 to fulfilment
07 | 09:00:00 | step_pending | book_shipment | AWAITING_CALLBACK | waiting for fulfilment to call back
08 | 10:30:00 | callback_accepted | book_shipment | CALLBACK_ACCEPTED | confirmed as fulfilment-1
09 | 10:30:00 | step_dispatched | capture_payment | DISPATCHED | attempt 1 to payments
10 | 10:30:00 | step_rejected | capture_payment | REFUSED | REFUSED: payments refused capture_payment
11 | 10:30:00 | transition | — | STEP_FAILED_BEFORE_PIVOT | RUNNING --step_failed--> COMPENSATING
12 | 10:30:00 | compensation_dispatched | book_shipment | COMPENSATION_DISPATCHED | attempt 1: cancel_shipment to fulfilment
13 | 10:30:00 | compensation_accepted | book_shipment | COMPENSATION_ACCEPTED | accepted as fulfilment-2
14 | 10:30:00 | compensation_dispatched | authorize_payment | COMPENSATION_DISPATCHED | attempt 1: void_authorization to payments
15 | 10:30:00 | compensation_failed | authorize_payment | UNAVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE
16 | 10:30:00 | compensation_dispatched | authorize_payment | COMPENSATION_DISPATCHED | attempt 2: void_authorization to payments
17 | 10:30:00 | compensation_failed | authorize_payment | UNAVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE
18 | 10:30:00 | compensation_dispatched | authorize_payment | COMPENSATION_DISPATCHED | attempt 3: void_authorization to payments
19 | 10:30:00 | compensation_failed | authorize_payment | UNAVAILABLE | UNAVAILABLE
20 | 10:30:00 | compensation_failed | authorize_payment | COMPENSATION_EXHAUSTED | attempts exhausted
21 | 10:30:00 | transition | — | COMPENSATION_EXHAUSTED | COMPENSATING --compensation_exhausted--> COMPENSATION_FAILED
22 | 10:31:00 | operator | — | OPERATOR_ACTION | operator retry
23 | 10:31:00 | transition | — | OPERATOR_RETRY | COMPENSATION_FAILED --operator_retried--> COMPENSATING
24 | 10:31:00 | compensation_dispatched | authorize_payment | COMPENSATION_DISPATCHED | attempt 1: void_authorization to payments
25 | 10:31:00 | compensation_accepted | authorize_payment | COMPENSATION_ACCEPTED | accepted as payments-2
26 | 10:31:00 | compensation_dispatched | reserve_stock | COMPENSATION_DISPATCHED | attempt 1: release_stock to inventory
27 | 10:31:00 | compensation_accepted | reserve_stock | COMPENSATION_ACCEPTED | accepted as inventory-2
28 | 10:31:00 | transition | — | ALL_COMPENSATIONS_DONE | COMPENSATING --compensations_complete--> COMPENSATED
```
